tools.name: product_manifest
tools.description: Return the machine-readable Agent Revenue Copilot product manifest, price, buyer fit, payment routes, and safety rules.

tools.name: route_triage
tools.description: Recommend free playbook, $1.99 triage, or $9.90 starter audit based on the buyer's target and route type.

target_usd.description: Approximate target earning amount in USD, if known.

goal.description: Short description of the earning or monetization goal.

route_type.description: Examples: one_off, repeated_income, x402, mcp, marketplace, unknown.

constraints.description: Known constraints such as no_kyc, no_deposit, no_social, no_user_funds.

tools.name: buyer_routes
tools.description: Return primary purchase choices plus active x402, direct USDC, and order-intake routes.

tools.name: checkout_diagnostics
tools.description: Return a one-path checkout recommendation, route readiness map, operator handoff instructions, and payment evidence requirements.

can_pay_x402.description: True if the buyer agent/operator can complete an x402 payment.

can_pay_base_usdc.description: True if the buyer can send exact USDC on Base mainnet.

needs_operator_handoff.description: True if the agent can inspect but cannot autonomously pay.

target_usd.description: Approximate buyer target value in USD, if known.

tools.name: operator_approval_request
tools.description: Generate a copy-ready operator approval request for agents that can inspect checkout but cannot pay autonomously.

requested_route.description: Preferred route: agoragentic_x402, agent402, direct_base_usdc, mcplug_triage, direct_triage_usdc, or free_playbook.

target_usd.description: Approximate buyer target value in USD, if known.

agent_stack.description: Agent/operator stack, for example Codex, Claude, custom MCP agent, or browser agent.

current_blocker.description: Why the agent needs operator approval or payment help.

constraints.description: Safety or route constraints such as no_kyc, no_deposit, no_social, no_user_funds.

tools.name: buyer_intent_intake
tools.description: Return the no-login buyer intent endpoint and a safe payload for non-secret checkout friction. This does not count as payment or unlock paid delivery.

requested_route.description: Preferred route, such as agoragentic_x402, direct_base_usdc, mcplug_triage, or unknown.

goal.description: Short non-secret buyer goal or purchase reason.

constraints.description: Safety constraints such as no_kyc, no_deposit, no_social, no_user_funds.

contact.description: Optional non-secret reply channel, if the buyer wants follow-up.

tools.name: free_playbook
tools.description: Return the free AI Agent Earn USDC playbook lead magnet.

tools.name: failure_paths
tools.description: Return routes that agents should usually skip first when trying to earn real spendable value.

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Check the direct Base USDC invoice balance for the $9.90 starter audit.
